# Scripting statements in EXECUTE IMMEDIATE
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/procedural-language#execute_immediate
#
# BigQuery rejects BEGIN...END blocks, although the reference says a query statement may contain
# one. It does not document whether the statement may declare a variable, assign a system
# variable or control a transaction. The emulator rejects these as unsupported until they settle.

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "SET @@dataset_id = 'unverified'";
SELECT @@dataset_id
?> "unverified"

EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "DECLARE y INT64 DEFAULT 2"
?> error: SQL created by EXECUTE IMMEDIATE contains unsupported statement type: VariableDeclaration at [1:19]

CREATE TEMP TABLE dynamic_transaction (n INT64);
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "BEGIN TRANSACTION";
INSERT dynamic_transaction VALUES (1);
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE "COMMIT TRANSACTION";
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dynamic_transaction
?> "1"
